plays.summary: Our defenders withstand a dangerous attack down the opponent's left wing and clear the ball out of the penalty area to launch a counter.

players.note: Like Virgil van Dijk, staying composed inside the box to read the danger and clear the threat cleanly.

plays.summary: Our central midfielder hits a long through ball over the top to send the striker into a 1v1 duel inside the box, ending in a shot wide of the goal.

players.note: Like Kevin De Bruyne, spotting the forward run early and weighting an accurate long ball into space behind the back line.
Great pace and strength to hold off the defender, but next time keep your head over the ball and strike low across the goalkeeper to hit the target.

plays.summary: Our team wins possession in midfield and links several short passes up the far side before a final through ball into the box runs to the opponent goalkeeper.

players.note: Like Toni Kroos, winning the ball cleanly and using simple one- and two-touch passing to keep the move flowing.
The idea to slip the runner into the box was right, so next time take a touch off the pace of the pass so the striker can reach it before the goalkeeper.

plays.summary: An opponent midfielder dribbles across the center of the pitch and draws a foul from our player, conceding a free kick.

players.note: Do not dive in when the attacker already has momentum across midfield; stay on your feet, jockey, and force them away from goal.

plays.summary: Our back line defends a long free kick into our box and wins possession to counter-attack, though the long forward pass goes too far.

players.note: Like Sergio Ramos, attacking the bouncing ball aggressively at the edge of the box to shut down the set-piece threat.
Look up before launching the early long ball on the counter; take an extra touch if needed so you can weight the pass into your winger's stride.

plays.summary: After winning the ball in our own half, our midfielder switches play with a lofted pass to the right winger, who brings it down and dribbles into the box to win a corner.

players.note: Like N'Golo Kante, stepping in cleanly to win possession and immediately laying it off to start the transition.
Like Xabi Alonso, lifting his head early and delivering an accurate diagonal ball over the defense into space.
Like Bukayo Saka, cushioning the aerial pass on the run and attacking the full-back 1v1 to earn a corner.

plays.summary: An opponent winger breaks down our right flank and plays a ball toward the box, which our defender intercepts and clears to safety.

players.note: Like Thiago Silva, reading the cross early and positioning yourself inside the danger zone to clear cleanly.

plays.summary: Our players combine tightly along the near touchline under pressure to escape our defensive half and push play forward.

players.note: Like Luka Modric, staying calm in tight space to shield the ball and thread a forward pass out of pressure.

plays.summary: A long free kick from deep in our half sets up our attacking midfielder at the edge of the box to thread a clever through ball, and our striker finishes cleanly into the net.

players.note: Like Trent Alexander-Arnold, driving a purposeful long free kick from deep into a dangerous central zone.
Like Martin Odegaard, controlling the second ball near the arc and slipping an incisive pass into the striker's stride.
Like Erling Haaland, timing the run inside the box and burying the 1v1 finish past the goalkeeper.
